messages:
arjun: hi all, first week q — opened a PR but buildkite ran and passed, yet GitHub shows 'required check missing' and won't let me merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood/example/pull/48
lee: welcome @arjun! can you paste the failing check name shown on the PR?
arjun: it lists 'buildkite/status' as required but the PR only shows 'buildkite/ci' in the checks list. logs from the PR UI:
```
Required check 'buildkite/status' not found
All required reviews and checks must pass before merging
```
jen: hmm, sounds like branch protection expects a status context that we stopped sending after renaming the pipeline. did this repo get a pipeline rename recently?
arjun: not that I'm aware of. i forked the repo two days ago though.
infra-oncall: @jen we did rename the main pipeline last week (migrated from redwood-ci->redwood-ci/main). Looks like some repos still have old protection contexts. i'll update branch protection if that's the easiest.
lee: alternatively we can resend the old status context from the webhook adapter (we kept backward-compat alias). but updating branch protection is better long-term.
buildkite-bot: buildkite pipeline "redwood-ci/main" finished for PR #48 (job id: bk-7711) — passed ✅
status-bot: status update attempted for context 'buildkite/ci'
arjun: why is GH still expecting 'buildkite/status' specifically?
infra-oncall: github branch protection keeps the exact string. if an admin changed the expected context for some repos but not others that causes these mismatches. i can change the protection for this repo to require 'buildkite/ci' instead.
jen: @infra-oncall please update, and then trigger a re-request for statuses (or push an empty commit) so merge check re-evaluates.
infra-oncall: done — updated branch protection to require 'buildkite/ci'. also re-requested status via API. you should see the merge button enable shortly.
arjun: i see the checks reevaluated and merge is enabled now. thanks!
lee: welcome to the repo @arjun :wave: we have a quick onboarding note about CI expectations in the handbook — ping me if you want a walkthrough of the pipeline steps.
arjun: would love that — also happy to help update any docs if useful. thanks everyone for the quick assist :)
jen: big :tada: welcome and congrats on first merge once you do it. if you hit more odd PR/CI state, ping #eng-infra and tag @infra-oncall.
